# Configuration inventory

<!-- Generated by agents-config docs. Edit config/inventory.json and its referenced manifests. -->

This lists declared configuration and update instructions, not current authentication status.
Secret values, OAuth state, backups, and machine check results are never included.

Start with `agents-config list`, `agents-config show ITEM`, or `agents-config check`.
Use `check --live` for registered provider reads. Checks never apply configuration.

<a id="cloudflare-dns-token"></a>

## cloudflare.dns-token

All-domains DNS token used by the pinned CLI, hosting helper, and hosted MCP.

Owner: **agents**.

Location: `~/.agents/local/credentials/cloudflare.env`.

Variable names: `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`.

Declared permissions: `Zone: DNS Edit for all zones`, `Zone: Zone Read for all zones`, `User: User Details Read`.

Consumers: `cloudflare.cli`, `cloudflare.mcp`, `hosting.paul`.

Provider label: Agent DNS — all domains. Scope was user-authorized and verified on 2026-10-14; use check --live to establish current access.

The profile is ignored, owner-only mode 600, in an owner-only mode-700 directory. No token value belongs in this inventory.

The profile also contains the non-secret account selector. The default zone is deliberately unbound; project manifests choose their zone.

Permissions are the dashboard-confirmed declared grant. Read-only checks prove token/user/zone/DNS reads, not DNS Edit or all-zone grants. The deprecated zone.permissions field is not API-token introspection.

[Update and recovery instructions](../docs/runbooks/cloudflare-token.md).

<a id="railway-webarts-token"></a>

## railway.webarts-token

Explicit Railway workspace profile for WebArts and Paul.

Owner: **agents**.

Location: `~/.config/railway/webarts.env`.

Variable names: `RAILWAY_API_TOKEN`.

Declared permissions: `Existing workspace access; do not infer scope from account identity endpoint failures`.

Consumers: `railway.mcp`, `hosting.paul`.

The existing profile remains outside this repository. It is owner-only mode 600. Inventory records its location; this task does not migrate or rotate it.

[Update and recovery instructions](../docs/runbooks/railway.md).

<a id="railway-legacy-profile"></a>

## railway.legacy-profile

Legacy shell credential source for another Railway workspace.

Owner: **reference**.

Location: `~/.secrets.sh`.

Variable names: `RAILWAY_API_TOKEN`.

Reference only. This shell script may contain other credentials or commands; inventory checks do not read or source it. Never substitute its token for the explicitly selected workspace profile.

[Update and recovery instructions](../docs/runbooks/railway.md).

<a id="environment-cloudflare"></a>

## environment.cloudflare

Cloudflare authentication and target selector variable names.

Owner: **agents**.

Variable names: `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`, `CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID`.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN is secret. Account/zone IDs are non-secret selectors.

Pinned CLI and MCP wrappers load the credential profile over inherited variables. Hosting API uses manifest account/zone selectors before profile selectors. CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID is optional and absent from the current all-domains profile.

If a zone selector is absent from the profile, an inherited CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID can still be a fallback. Inspect or unset it when switching project context.

[Update and recovery instructions](../docs/runbooks/cloudflare-token.md).

<a id="environment-railway"></a>

## environment.railway

Railway workspace credentials, CI credentials, and target selectors.

Owner: **agents**.

Variable names: `RAILWAY_API_TOKEN`, `RAILWAY_TOKEN`, `RAILWAY_PROJECT_ID`, `RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_ID`, `RAILWAY_SERVICE_ID`, `RAILWAY_IAC_BRANCH`.

RAILWAY_API_TOKEN and RAILWAY_TOKEN are secret. IDs and branch names are selectors.

Workspace launchers clear inherited Railway tokens before loading the selected profile. RAILWAY_TOKEN is project/environment CI access; its value is maintained in the relevant CI secret store, not this registry.

[Update and recovery instructions](../docs/runbooks/railway.md).

<a id="configuration-codex-defaults"></a>

## configuration.codex-defaults

Version-controlled, deliberately managed non-secret Codex preferences.

Owner: **agents**.

Location: `config/codex.defaults.toml`.

Consumers: `configuration.codex`.

The installer owns model, model_reasoning_effort, model_verbosity, model_reasoning_summary, web_search, and service_tier when present in this file.

Captured from the current machine without changing their values. Other preferences, host paths, and application state remain in the ignored active config. Project config and runtime overrides can take precedence.

[Update and recovery instructions](../docs/runbooks/configuration.md).

<a id="cloudflare-mcp"></a>

## cloudflare.mcp

Official hosted Cloudflare MCP with token-backed internal auth.

Owner: **agents**.

The header helper emits credentials to the application auth pipe. Never invoke it to display or log its output.

Codex uses the owner-only profile through the header helper. Cursor has its own OAuth connection state and may require sign-in. A URL alone is not authenticated access.

[Update and recovery instructions](../docs/runbooks/cloudflare-token.md).

[Update and recovery instructions](../docs/runbooks/railway.md).

<a id="hosting-paul"></a>

## hosting.paul

Paul Railway environments, source branches, domains, and credential-profile references.

Owner: **agents**.

The Paul manifest owns stable IDs and main/dev versus prod/production mappings. scripts/hosting.py validates those identities before DNS work. A broad credential does not authorize unrelated mutations.

<a id="application-codex-auth"></a>

## application.codex-auth

Codex-managed sign-in and credential storage.

Owner: **application**.

Credential storage is controlled by the active cli_auth_credentials_store setting. Codex may use its native auth file or OS credential store.

Use codex login status to inspect sign-in and the supported login flow to restore it. Do not copy auth data into shared config. Local inventory checks do not read auth storage.

[Update and recovery instructions](../docs/runbooks/configuration.md).

<a id="local-backups"></a>

## local.backups

Ignored installer backups, plans, journals, verification reports, and screenshots.

Owner: **application**.

Location: `local/`.

Installer backups can contain credentials or private application settings. Keep them ignored and owner-only; backup references and recovery steps live in the runbooks.

local/inventory/status.json is a sanitized observation, not durable proof of current provider access. Git does not back up secret values; keep an encrypted backup or a replacement procedure.

[Update and recovery instructions](../docs/runbooks/configuration.md).

<a id="configuration-inventory"></a>

## configuration.inventory

Customization metadata index, schema, generated documentation, and change history.

Owner: **agents**.

Edit registered metadata in config/inventory.json; existing manifests own settings and locations. Run agents-config docs to regenerate the Markdown view.

The schema forbids secret-value fields. Local verification results remain ignored observations; meaningful changes belong in CHANGELOG.md and Git/PR history.

[Update and recovery instructions](../docs/runbooks/utilities.md).

<a id="configuration-profiles"></a>

## configuration.profiles

Single source of credential profile IDs and file locations for wrappers, hosting, and inventory.

Owner: **agents**.

Profile IDs such as cloudflare.default and railway.webarts resolve through this catalog. Hosting manifests select IDs; explicit file paths remain supported for ad hoc profiles. Do not put values in the catalog.

[Update and recovery instructions](../docs/runbooks/configuration.md).

<a id="tools-python"></a>

## tools.python

Pinned, hash-verified TOML editor for preserving application configuration.

Owner: **agents**.

Location: `local/python-packages`.

Restore with the README pip command into ignored local/python-packages. No global Python packages are changed. Inventory metadata lookup and generation remain standard-library operations; configuration rendering uses the pinned editor.

[Update and recovery instructions](../docs/runbooks/utilities.md).

<a id="application-github-auth"></a>

## application.github-auth

GitHub CLI authentication and separate agent-connector account state.

Owner: **application**.

GitHub CLI uses its native credential store and configuration under ~/.config/gh. Do not copy credentials into this repository. Select the intended repository owner/host explicitly.

Use gh api user --jq .login to confirm the CLI account without printing tokens. Agent GitHub connectors have their own selected connection; CLI authentication does not establish connector identity.

Change sign-in through supported gh auth login/account selection or the connector settings within the current task authorization. Inventory does not inspect native credential values.

[Update and recovery instructions](../docs/runbooks/configuration.md).
